Apartments
Furnished, spacious and with your own fully-equipped kitchen
Settle in with a relaxed living area, en-suite bathroom(s) and 24-hour reception. Kitchens for optimum flexibility, and The 51 downstairs for eating together. Everything you need for a short or extended stay in Amsterdam.

Studio — 25m² • Sleeps 2
Everything you need for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam, whether you're visiting for a few nights or a few weeks. Make the most of your own kitchen, twin beds or a double bed, and plenty of space to work, dine and relax.
Room page: Twin beds; Sleeps 2; 25 m2. Everything you need for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam, whether you're visiting for a few nights or a few weeks. Enjoy your own kitchen with a dishwasher and microwave oven, plus twin beds or a double bed. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided every seven days.
Facilities: Fully-equipped kitchen; work table; Dining area; Bathroom; Climate control; Smart TV; High-speed Wi-Fi; Access to Gym & Sauna.

About us
Feel at home from the moment you arrive at ID Aparthotel. Our spacious Amsterdam apartments combine the comfort of a home with the convenience of a hotel, with furnished living spaces, fully-equipped kitchens and private bathrooms.
Enjoy everything you need for a comfortable short or extended stay in Amsterdam, including 24-hour reception and complimentary access to our gym, wellness and laundry facilities. With the flexibility to cook, work and relax in your own space and The 51 restaurant downstairs on busier days, our apartments are ideal for business trips, city breaks and longer stays.
Located less than 200 metres from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station, ID Aparthotel offers excellent transport connections to Amsterdam city centre, Schiphol Airport and destinations across the Netherlands.
Our story: ID Aparthotel first opened its doors in 2012, transforming a former office building on Naritaweg 51 into a collection of 28 apartments near Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station. The property was fully renovated in 2017 and has expanded to 127 apartments. We're now part of The July, continuing our original vision of giving guests more space, flexibility and the comforts of home when staying in Amsterdam.

Facilities
Make your stay as pleasant as possible with our complimentary hotel facilities and services!
ID Aparthotel has a wide range of facilities that you can use during your stay. At The 51, you can enjoy a delicious breakfast, drinks and dinner. Are you in need of relaxation? Go to our game room or completely unwind in the sauna. Up for a tough fitness session? ID Aparthotel features a spacious gym with new TechnoGym equipment.
The 51: From freshly made pizzas to local beers and wines on tap, The 51 is the perfect place to unwind after a day in the city.
Fitness studio: Keep up your workout in our fully equipped gym, featuring cardio machines, free weights and functional training equipment. Complimentary for all hotel guests.
Sauna: Recharge and unwind in our infrared sauna. Relax after a busy day.
Game room: Challenge your friends, family or colleagues to a game of pool or table football. The perfect place to have some fun!
Laundry: Freshen up your wardrobe with our self-service laundry facilities. Washing, drying and detergent are available for a small fee.
Parking garage: Enjoy secure on-site parking with EV charging facilities. Reserve your parking space in advance or at reception. Available for a daily fee.

The 51 Restaurant & Bar
Breakfast, drinks & dinner at ID Aparthotel
From breakfast and coffee to local drinks, dinner and after-work catch-ups, The 51 is your go-to spot at ID Aparthotel. Enjoy relaxed dining just minutes from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station.
A place to eat, drink and unwind: Just steps from your apartment, The 51 is a modern gastropub serving breakfast, dinner and local drinks.
All-day dining at The 51: From early breakfasts and coffee to handcrafted pizzas, sharing bites and local drinks, The 51 has you covered throughout the day.
Be your own bartender: Discover The 51’s signature Tap Wall, where you can pour your own selection of local beers and wines.
Stay a little longer: Keep the evening going at The 51. Challenge friends to a game of pool or table football, pick out a board game, or settle into the cosy lounge with a drink.
The terrace: Take your time, grab a drink and settle in on our terrace.

Meeting & events spaces in Amsterdam
Flexible meeting rooms and event spaces in Amsterdam Sloterdijk.
Host your next meeting, workshop, conference, corporate event or private gathering at The 51, located inside ID Aparthotel. Our flexible meeting rooms and event spaces accommodate up to 150 guests, with modern AV equipment, tailored catering and the option to stay overnight.
Andreas — 9 guests, 13m². Ideal for smaller meetings and workshops of up to 9 guests. Share ideas on the whiteboard wall and present decks on the projection screen. Glass walls brings in plenty of light, with curtains available for added privacy. The room is set up with air conditioning, high speed Wi-Fi and modern AV equipment. Tailored catering available when booking.
Persijn — 9 guests, 13m². Ideal for smaller meetings, brainstorming sessions and creative workshops of up to 9 guests.
Andreas + Persijn — 20 guests, 26m². Combine Andreas and Persijn to create a flexible meeting room for groups of up to 20 guests.
The Lion — 24 guests, 31m². Bright meeting room designed for up to 24 guests.
Adam — 150 guests, 143m². Our largest event space, with flexible space for up to 150 guests. Layouts including U-shaped, theatre-style and more.
The 51 events: Looking for the perfect venue for your drinks, birthday, or corporate event? At The 51, you can not only enjoy delicious pizzas and a relaxed atmosphere, but also host your very own event. With comfortable seating, a cozy bar, and the unique Tap Wall where you can pour your own beer and wine.
Why host at The 51? Our restaurant & bar, The 51, offers space for up to 150 guests. Enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner, canapé and drinks catering in a relaxed venue with a spacious and furnished private terrace open through warmer months.
Stay the night: No need to travel between venues. Combine your meeting, dinner and overnight stay in one convenient location at ID Aparthotel.
Meeting FAQ: on-site underground parking garage including electric vehicle charging points (subject to availability); 5-minute walk from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station; several meeting rooms can be combined; catering options including coffee breaks, business lunches, private dinners, drinks and walking dinners; overnight stays in fully equipped apartments; largest setup up to 150 guests in theatre style; Schiphol Airport 10 minutes and Amsterdam Central Station 6 minutes by train (meeting FAQ). Homepage location copy also prints Amsterdam Central as one train stop / around 5 minutes.

Special offers
Save on breakfast: Book with breakfast included and enjoy our breakfast buffet for just €14.50 per person. Book our Most Flexible including Breakfast rate and enjoy our breakfast buffet for just €14.50 per person, per night. When booked separately, breakfast is €19.50 per adult and €12.00 per child (up to 12 years). Infants up to 3 years eat for free. Our breakfast buffet includes pastries, fresh fruit, yoghurt, granola, a cooked breakfast, a range of hot and cold drinks, and more. Monday to Friday: 07:00 – 10:30. Saturday & Sunday: 08:00 – 11:00.
Stay 4+ Nights & Save 15% / Extended stay: Stay 4+ nights at ID Aparthotel and save 15%. Settle into your own spacious apartment with a fully equipped kitchen, living space and hotel service, just minutes from Amsterdam Sloterdijk. 4+ nights: 15% off + priority room allocation. 7+ nights: Everything above + early check-in from 12:00. 10+ nights: Everything above + late check-out until 14:00 + complimentary airport pick-up. The longer you stay, the more you get. Your Amsterdam base, made for staying a little longer.
Dog friendly: Travelling with your four-legged companion is easy with our dog-friendly apartments. Bring your dog along and make yourself feel fully at home at ID Aparthotel. Our dog-friendly apartments give you and your four-legged companion the space to settle in, with our add-on Dog Friendly Kit package providing everything they need for a comfortable stay. Our dog package includes a dog mat/bed, two dog bowls, a feeding mat, a toy and a treat. Select package when booking your stay.
Work from home: Your office for the day. Stay productive with our Work From Home Kit, designed for those who want the flexibility to work comfortably from their apartment. For €5 per night, the kit includes a second screen, laptop stand, mouse and keyboard, mousepad and desk or reading light. Choose a 1+ Bedroom Apartment for easy work/ life balance.

News — Dog friendly stays
Whether you're staying for a short city break or a longer visit, your dog is part of your stay at Amsterdam ID Aparthotel. Each kit includes a comfortable dog bed (subject to availability), a water bowl, and toys for a relaxed, stress-free stay. Located next to Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station. Nearby dog-friendly highlights printed: Westerpark, Sloterpark, Brettenzone, Rembrandtpark. Back at the hotel, our spacious apartments give both you and your dog plenty of room to relax. With fully equipped kitchens, comfortable living areas and hotel services such as a 24-hour reception, housekeeping, a gym and sauna, you'll have everything you need for a comfortable stay.

News — Apartments with sofa beds
Selected apartments can accommodate up to one additional guests with the option of adding a sofa bed during the booking process. At Amsterdam ID Aparthotel you'll enjoy: Spacious apartments with separate living areas; Fully equipped kitchens in every apartment; Comfortable living and dining spaces; Flexible sleeping arrangements with selected sofa beds; Hotel services including housekeeping and a 24-hour reception; Wellness facilities including a gym and sauna; Excellent public transport connections, just a short walk from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station.

FAQ (official)
What is an aparthotel? An aparthotel combines the freedom of an apartment with the services of a hotel. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, spacious living area and hotel services such as a 24-hour reception, weekly housekeeping and complimentary Wi-Fi.
What's included in the apartment? Every apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen, dining and living area, private bathroom, comfortable beds, Smart TV, Wi-Fi and climate control.
Do all apartments have a kitchen? Yes. Every apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, freezer, dishwasher, stovetop, oven or microwave, kettle and coffee maker.
How often is housekeeping provided? Housekeeping is included every seven days for both short and long stays. Additional cleaning is available upon request for an additional fee.
Are towels and bed linen included? Yes. Fresh towels and bed linen are included and refreshed during the scheduled housekeeping service.
Are baby cots and extra beds available? Yes. Baby cots are available free of charge upon request. Extra beds are available for selected apartment types at an additional cost.
Is parking available? Yes. Secure parking is available in our underground parking garage. Electric vehicle charging points are available, subject to availability.
Can I charge my electric vehicle? Yes. EV charging stations are available in our underground parking garage.
Is Wi-Fi included? Yes. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel and in every apartment.
Is there a gym? Yes. Hotel guests have complimentary access to our gym between 7:00 AM and 11:00 PM.
Is there a sauna? Yes. Self-service washing machines and dryers are available for guests in the shared laundry area. (FAQ answer printed as-is; facilities page separately prints an infrared sauna.)
Can I rent a bicycle? Yes. Bicycles are available to rent, making it easy to explore Amsterdam like a local. Book direct and get the bicycle for free during your stay.
Is breakfast available? Yes. Breakfast is served daily at The 51 Gastropub.
Is your reception open 24/7? Yes. Our reception is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, so we're always here to help.
Do you have luggage storage? Yes. You're welcome to store your luggage before check-in or after check-out while you explore Amsterdam.
Can I bring my dog? Yes. Dogs are welcome at ID Aparthotel. Charges depend on the length of your stay.
Are other pets allowed? Small pets may be accepted on request. Please contact us before your arrival to discuss the options.
How far is Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station? We're just a short walk from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station, with direct connections to Schiphol Airport and Amsterdam city centre.
How do I get to Schiphol Airport? Schiphol Airport is easily reached by direct train from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station.
Is the hotel easy to reach by car? Yes. ID Aparthotel is conveniently located near the A10 motorway with on-site parking available.
Is Amsterdam Central Station easy to reach? Yes. Amsterdam Central Station is just one train stop away and can be reached in around 5 minutes from Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station.
Do you offer group bookings? Yes. We offer group bookings for more than 5 apartments or 10 guests, as well as long-term stays. Contact stay@amsterdamidaparthotel.com
Do you offer long-stay rates? Yes. We offer special long-stay rates for stays of 14 nights or longer. Contact our reservations team for availability and a personalised quote. stay@amsterdamidaparthotel.com. FAQ “Book extended stay” button: https://app.mews.com/distributor/c71d07c8-541a-4be3-9c13-b483007bd895
Can I register at the hotel? Yes. Registration is possible for stays of 30 nights or longer.
What time are check-in and check-out? Check-in is available from 3:00 PM, and check-out is before 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are available subject to availability.

House rules / terms (official)
Check-in from 15:00 hours; check-out before 11:00 hours. Amsterdam ID Aparthotel is a cash free property. Accepts American Express, Mastercard, PayPal and Visa; Maestro at the hotel.
Rates are inclusive of heating and hot water costs, linen and towels, TV, WiFi usage, and weekly cleaning. Unless stated otherwise, rates also include 21% VAT. Excluding the city tax of 12,5% of the room rate.
Security deposits: Studio, Studio Executive & 1-Bedroom Executive: € 100; 2-Bedroom Apartment € 200; 3-Bedroom Apartment € 300; 4-Bedroom Apartment € 400. (Live rooms list prints One Bedroom Apartment; sitemap redirect rooms/one-bedroom-executive → /rooms/one-bedroom-apartment. No separate live 1-Bedroom Executive card.)
All apartments are fully furnished to a high standard and include a fully equipped kitchen with appliances, cutlery, crockery, and kitchen utensils. No food is provided. A welcome pack is provided on arrival. This consists of tea, coffee, sugar and sufficient washing liquid.
Unless otherwise specified, the prices quoted include: weekly cleaning service, heating, electricity, gas, water, VAT, television/cable license and internet. The price also includes linen and towels, which are changed every 3 days. (Room pages / FAQ print towels and bed linen every seven days.)
Sauna/Gym: All guests of the hotel are allowed to make use of the sauna and gym without any additional fees. People under the age of 18 are not allowed to use the gym or sauna without adult supervision.
Parking: The company provides secured parking for €20,00 per night (or € 13,50 per night for direct bookings). The gated garage is located under the hotel. Address printed: Orly centre N2.
Extra set of linen or towels: €35,-.
Pets: We do accept some types of pets on request. Cleaning fees may apply.
Smoking & Laughing Gas: In all apartments we have a non-smoking and laughing gas policy! Doing so leads to a recovery fee of € 400,- and a final warning.
Wheelchair accessibility: Our hotel is wheelchair accessible.
A safe is provided in the apartment for any valuables.
Upon check-out used tableware, cutlery and glasses are placed in the dishwasher and the dishwasher should be turned on.
Group Reservations or Long-term Rental: Reservations for more than 3 rooms or 10 people or have an adjusted policy. Please contact reservations@amsterdamidaparthotel.com
Sustainability page: Since 2023, our hotel is Green Globe certified. 127 full-service apartments. Hotels for Trees. Dishwasher eco setting printed. Sustainability feedback: info@amsterdamidaparthotel.com

make it at the makerstoren
A progressive creative hub where community and comfort make sky-high ambitions come true.
The MAKERSTOREN is open. Since March 2026, our forward-thinking creative hub has been home to creators, professionals and temporary residents of Amsterdam. We offer workspaces to creative enterprises and rent out a diverse range of short-stay flats for working and studying guests (28 days – 6 months) — a 5-minute cycle from Sloterdijk Station and 15 minutes from the city centre.
Curious about your spot? Check availability, conditions and prices below and book directly.
MAKERSTOREN stands for fostering talent, promoting innovation and supporting growth - of the makers, the area and the city. MAKERSTOREN is the capital's new creative hub. Serviced corporate short-stay flats, creative workspaces and a progressive community of makers who organise meetings and eat at our in-house restaurant; all in one striking tower in Amsterdam Sloterdijk. We believe in the power of community building and the connecting role culture plays in this. The multifaceted character, innovative DNA and service orientation of the MAKERSTOREN bring out the best in makers.

Exclusive Temporary Living Space in Amsterdam | Serviced Apartments & Long Stay Rentals
Serviced Apartments Amsterdam Rent
Short-stay serviced apartments for urban nomads
With one part of the creative hub dedicated to high-end temporary corporate housing, MAKERSTOREN is the perfect opportunity for urban nomads and ambitious newcomers to make it here. From day one, residents are immersed in the local creative scene, entirely in sync with the city dynamics and themselves. Everything at MAKERSTOREN is designed to support makers in achieving their potential in Amsterdam’s most exciting area.
Flats as an extension of your business: Our fresh approach offers the possibility to rent multiple apartments on one floor exclusively for your international workforce. What’s more, our tailor-made services include the option of extending your brand identity within the interior design of the spaces, supporting continuous brand awareness, and identity and promoting mutual understanding among co-workers — even when they are off duty.
A PLACE TO BELONG: Being part of a thriving community promotes happiness, boosts performance and enhances our sense of belonging. That’s why MAKERSTOREN boasts ample “crossroads” for spontaneous social interaction: several communal indoor spaces on the ground floor and top floor — a bar, restaurant, lounge area, gym, a lush park with workout stations outside, right at our doorstep, and a community app. A great temporary home is more than a high-end interior and lots of incoming daylight. We help people navigate their way through town with a curated cultural agenda, and by offering E-bike rental.

FAQ (official English) — booking, prices, stay, house rules
To book
I would like to rent a space, how do I do that? To rent a temporary living space, check out this page and for the range of workspaces, see this page. Is your ideal space not listed here? Then sign up to receive the latest offers based on your requirements by e-mail.
What do we accept as a work statement/ proof of study? During online check-in, we ask for the submission of a statement/proof of (intention to) work or study in Amsterdam. We prefer to receive proof of your studies/client but we also encourage a declaration of new entrepreneurship or remote working.
Can I also rent a temporary flat for shorter than 28 days or longer than 6 months? Rental periods are minimum 28 days to maximum 6 months. Longer or shorter is really not possible.
Can I rent a serviced apartment if I am a minor? No, only tenants over the age of 18 will be allowed. A parental consent form will not be accepted.
Are children welcome? No, in the Makerstoren there is no possibility to book a room with children.
Can I bring pets? Pets are not allowed
How many people can I stay in the apartment with? The flat may only be used as temporary living space for a maximum of two adults.
Are discounts possible? Published prices are non-negotiable.
Can I book for business? For corporate bookings of more than 3 rooms, please contact us directly for customised arrangements.
What is included in the rent? Rent is inclusive of VAT and includes: Consumption and standing charges for energy (heat) and water; Rubbish disposal; Sewerage levy, water board tax and purification levy; Cleaning; WiFi; Use of general bicycle parking. Longer FAQ variant: Municipal taxes (sewerage levy, water board tax and purification levy) These costs are included in the rent as long as you pay tourist tax, i.e. when you are not registered at this address. Do you register with the municipality at the address of Makerstoren? Then sewerage, water board tax and sewage treatment charges can be charged by the municipality in your own name and these charges are no longer included in the all-in rent.
When should I pay? All payments are due in advance and must be paid in full before or on the first day of the period to which they relate.
What happens if I don't pay on time? If you do not pay the rent on time, the landlord is not obliged to allow you into the serviced apartment.
Do I have to pay tourist tax? Whether you owe tourist tax depends on your situation: No tourist tax: You register at the address of the serviced apartment in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP)… / You are already registered as a resident of the municipality of Amsterdam. Tourist tax: All other bookings where you are not registered at the address. Tourist tax is automatically calculated and added to your bill in accordance with the applicable rates of the municipality of Amsterdam.
Can I register, and what does that mean for tax purposes? As a guest at Makerstoren, for bookings of more than 90 days, you have the option to register at our address in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP) of the City of Amsterdam.
Do I have to pay a deposit? The deposit is automatically added to your booking when applicable. You will see the deposit amount in your booking overview under the total cost.
When will I get my deposit back? The reservation on your credit card will be terminated at the end of the rental period, provided: The flat has been delivered in good condition (taking into account normal wear and tear); All keys and keycards have been handed in; No damage was detected; All payment obligations have been met.
Check-in is possible from 16:00 on the first day of your booking, on the last day of your booking you need to leave the serviced apartment at 11:00.
How often will my flat be cleaned? The cleaning frequency is basically once a week. Weekly cleaning includes linen changes.
Can I rent a bike and how does it work? Yes, we offer bike rental during your stay. Book your bike via the booking platform on our website during the booking process or afterwards via your booking confirmation. You pick up your bike key and bike at the Makerstoren office.
Can I host guests? A maximum of 2 people are allowed to stay in a flat, if you are renting on your own and want to temporarily accommodate a guest, this is possible but must be notified in writing.
Can I sublet the flat? No, it is not allowed to (sub)rent or give all or part of the serviced apartment to another person.
Can I use the flat for commercial purposes? No, the flat should only be used as accommodation and not for commercial activities.
Access to Makerstoren with iLOQ: At Makerstoren, we work with iLOQ's smart digital access system. This means you do not need a physical key, once you have received your digital key via SMS, you have instant access to the right spaces in the building. Official FAQ instructional videos: https://youtube.com/shorts/OILDneSg4aA ; https://youtube.com/shorts/jUrVv_OlZME ; https://youtube.com/shorts/5cmkiyps8CA
House rules: There is a general quiet time between 22:00 and 07:00 in which no noise may be produced that is audible in other flats. No, smoking is prohibited throughout the Makerstoren; however, smoking is allowed on balconies, terraces and outside at street level. Household waste is disposed of in the weekly cleaning, if you wish to dispose of additional waste you should deposit it in the designated bins in the car park. No, it is not allowed to make changes or additions without permission. This includes making holes (including screw and nail holes) in floors, ceilings or facades, and installing additional electrical appliances such as heaters, refrigerators or microwaves.
Bathroom (private): Shower; Toilet; Sink. Sleeping area: Wardrobe with hanging and laying section; Net curtains and blackout curtains; Vault. Climate control: Floor heating; Air conditioning (heating and cooling); Thermostat. Cleaning cupboard in the corridor: Ironing board/iron; Hoover.

Contact / location (official English)
Makerstoren is located at Rhoneweg 54 in Amsterdam Sloterdijk, a vibrant creative hotspot with excellent accessibility. The building is just 5 minutes from Sloterdijk Station, Amsterdam's second largest train station, with direct connections to Schiphol Airport (15 minutes) and cities such as The Hague, Rotterdam and Eindhoven.
Electric bikes for rent: At Makerstoren, you can rent electric bikes to easily explore the city. You can reach Amsterdam Central Station in about 10 minutes by bike, and Leidseplein in about 10 minutes as well.
By public transport from Schiphol: several direct trains to Sloterdijk Station (travel time: about 8 minutes). From Sloterdijk Station: bus 382 (towards IJmuiden) or 231 (towards Aberdeen); get off after 2 stops (5 minutes) at stop 'Oderweg' — directly in front of our building.
Homepage: 5-minute cycle from Sloterdijk Station and 15 minutes from the city centre; Sloterdijk Station bridging the 12 km distance to Schiphol Airport in just 11 minutes. Type pages: Op 5 minuten fietsen van Station Sloterdijk, 15 minuten van de binnenstad en 11 minuten met de trein naar Schiphol.
PIONEERING IN THE CULTURAL HEART OF AMSTERDAM: The location of MAKERSTOREN is ideal, within walking distance of Amsterdam Sloterdijk station and with access to major highways. Schiphol Airport is only a 15-minute journey away, and the city centre beckons within a 15-minute bike ride. The MAKERSTOREN app supports the community and helps you find your way around the neighbourhood and the city with the latest cultural offerings.
IN THE AREA (homepage): Uptown Sloterdijk; Rhônepark (directly opposite — walking trails, jogging track, sports facilities, open-air theatre, tree campsite); Sloterdijk Station; Peakz Padel; Tuin van Bret; Vineyard Bret City; Circa Amsterdam; De Sloot / café-restaurant De Sering; Lofi; Club Raum; H7 Warehouse; Coffeeshop Boerenjongens.
